root_cause: Process-group ownership did not cover descendants that create a new session. CPU busy was window-averaged but load used only final sample.
changes: Exact trusted command allowlist; pnpm install disables lifecycle scripts; Vitest uses one worker and accepts positional test-file filters.
Inherited nonce census discovers ordinary Node/tool descendants across sessions; termination checks PID/start identity, retries census, retains lease on measurement/cleanup error.
Stale run acquisition automatically retries nonce cleanup; stale manual browser recovery requires explicit stopped-work assertion and dead-holder proof.
CPU admission now averages busy across entire window and pairs it with ANY high-load occurrence; PLAN and policy aligned.
Process environments are filtered in memory; never emitted to logs or reports.

verification.evidence: Scratch fake pnpm launches detached Node sleeper and exits; actual runner code stops sleeper before releasing lease, exits zero. Real macOS ps/spawn/signals/filesystem, only external resource measurements injected and timers shortened.

verification.case: high load early then low final
verification.evidence: Three .60 busy samples with load .8,.8,.2 normalized: refuses RESOURCE_CPU_HIGH_LOAD_BUSY, exit2.
/bin/sleep direct run refused RESOURCE_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED before acquisition.

limitations: Cooperative trusted-tool launch contract, NOT an OS security sandbox. Explicit coordinator ruling narrowed requirement to trusted campaign command resource/concurrency safety.

macOS ps hides environment of protected system binaries. A detached /bin/sleep proof escapes nonce census. Daemonizing commands and detached protected system-binary children are explicitly forbidden, as are environment scrubbing and external process brokers. Such binaries must remain in the foreground owned group.
A conservative all-new-process baseline was tested and removed per coordinator ruling: unrelated new same-user processes must not indefinitely block ordinary product work.
Manual browser stop remains an operator/agent assertion; guard cannot prove UI inactivity.
No product builds/tests/UI and no Git mutation. Full-minute real resource sampling not repeated; previous receipt remains source for measurement parsing.
next_action: Fresh reviewer verifies supported command scope and explicit limits, then coordinator runs first guarded development build.
